title: Quebec City & Old Quebec Highlights – 2‑Hour Private Driving Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Short on time but eager to experience the best of Quebec City? Join your local chauffeur-guide Danielle, for a private tour through the historic charm of Old Quebec and its vibrant surrounding neighbourhoods. Immerse yourself in captivating stories, stunning views, and a personalized journey designed to make your visit unforgettable. Dog-friendly tour (Upon request): This is a 100% private tour, so you can bring your dog along if they are clean and well-behaved. Message me before booking.
